title: Prepare cloud marketplace launch packages and release coordination (AWS / Azure / GCP)
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: Prepare ready-to-publish listing packages and go-to-market coordination artifacts for AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace. This ticket covers creating and validating publisher artifacts (images/AMIs/containers, Helm charts, VM templates), standardized release notes and changelog text tailored to each store, pricing/offer metadata, legal/contract inputs, telemetry and support routing configurations, and a cross-functional launch timeline. The outcome must be a single source-of-truth folder per cloud with all assets needed for submission and a runbook for post-publish monitoring and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Per-cloud package folder in GDrive (AWS | Azure | GCP) containing: listing copy, screenshots, packaging artifacts, tested deployment instructions, and validated pricing table
Release notes and changelog draft adapted to each marketplace description constraints and character limits
Billing connector & metering hooks validated with finance and engineering (test transactions executed in non-prod where possible)
Legal/compliance checklist completed (offer terms, data residency callouts, privacy blurb) and signed off by Legal
Marketplace-specific submission walkthroughs created for PMs/SEs with checklist for post-approve steps (support mapping, L1 triage, telemetry flags)
Cross-team launch timeline and owner matrix published and communicated to GTM and Partnerships
Rollback/entitlement freeze plan documented and tested (how to quickly unpublish or disable purchase flow)
Post-launch monitoring dashboard defined (errors, provisioning failures, lead generation metrics) and alerting owner assigned

notes: Packaging differences: AWS requires AMI + SaaS listing metadata; Azure encourages Managed Application or SaaS offer with ARM template; GCP prefers container+Marketplace SaaS connector or listing via partner portal.
Make sure to include 'known limitations' section for initial GA (e.g., single-region deployments, no autoscaling in certain older SKUs) to reduce support noise.
For billing: prefer usage-based metering where available; fallback to fixed recurring offers for Azure where metered plans are not approved yet.
